Select distinct compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
